description: Update Sequence Status - Start, pause, stop, or archive a sequence. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced. Setting status to ACTIVE starts sending emails to recipients, so the user must approve it. Returns a preview first; the action runs only when called again with the returned confirmation_token after the user has approved the preview. Pausing, stopping and archiving need no confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Only for status ACTIVE. Leave out on the first call. After the user has approved the preview, pass the confirmation_token that call returned.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: update_sequence_status

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Update Sequence Status
